verdict.label: Prices falling
verdict.headline: Card prices are falling: hold your coins and buy only cards you will play.
verdict.detail: Ezzcoins' Top 100 index is 103.9 (+4.2% in a day) and momentum is 42: prices are falling. 84s cost 900, 85s 2,200 and 86s 5,300. Midweek is usually the quietest time to buy cards for the weekend.

index.note: Ezzcoins' own index from live console prices, read at {{t:2026-10-13T21:11:00+01:00}}.

moves.title: Sell Jérémy Doku 84 after its 24% jump, expect it lower in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 17,000 coins. Now 18,000. Sell the spike: a card that jumped in a day often gives part of the jump back within two days. Picked because it is up 23.6% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. A sell call is a hit if the price is lower at check time.

moves.title: Buy Myles Lewis-Skelly 88 Future Stars after its 14% fall, sell in two days
moves.detail: Tracked call: in at 689,000 coins. Now 670,000. Buy the dip: a playable card that fell sharply in a day often recovers part of the fall within two days. Picked because it is down 13.8% in about a day. This is the strategy's first tracked call. It sells and buys back, so the 5% tax is counted.

moves.title: Quiet midweek: plan your weekend squad now
moves.detail: Midweek is usually the cheapest time to buy cards you will play at the weekend. The next Rivals rewards come {{t:2026-10-15T07:59:00+01:00}} and add fodder supply.

moves.title: Fodder: 85s are the best value per point, 88s the dearest
moves.detail: Cheapest prices: 84s 900 (1.08 coins per Item Score point), 85s 2,200 (1.05 coins per Item Score point), 86s 5,300 (1.29 coins per Item Score point), 87s 6,800 (1.24 coins per Item Score point), 88s 12,500 (1.51 coins per Item Score point). For SBCs that ask for an Item Score, 85s then 84s fill it cheapest. Use fodder in SBCs rather than trading it: selling costs the 5% tax.

moves.title: Barbara Bonansea and other falling cards: wait for the fall to flatten
moves.detail: Biggest falls in the last day: Barbara Bonansea 82 Rare -55.8%; Esmee Brugts 85 Team of the week -35.1%; Lewis Hall 86 Future Stars -28.7%; Theo Hernández 82 Rare -27.5%. Buy only cards you will play, and wait for two steady updates before buying.
